name: Pimachiowin Aki
description: Pimachiowin Aki, "the land that gives life," is a vast stretch of boreal forest, rivers, lakes and wetlands spanning more than 29,000 square kilometres across Manitoba and Ontario. It is the ancestral home of four Anishinaabeg communities, who still fish, hunt and gather here. Waterways link their camps, travel routes and ceremonial places, all shaped by a tradition of caring for the land.
